prompt: Original 45-second instrumental composition. Instruments exclusively: gentle pipe organ with quiet flute stops. 70 BPM. slow legato phrases with generous silence between notes. A distinctive concise motif, moderate variation every eight bars, no long introduction, clean resolved ending. Designed as a restrained background for a narrated video. No human voices, speech, singing, humming, choir or vocal samples. Clear natural instrument timbres with no feedback or clipping.

description.en: An epic and dramatic orchestral piece featuring a blend of woodwinds, strings, and percussion. It begins with a melancholic wind melody, gradually building in intensity and complexity with lush string arrangements and powerful percussion, creating a grand and cinematic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首史诗般且富有戏剧性的管弦乐作品，融合了木管乐器、弦乐器和打击乐器。它以忧郁的木管旋律开场，随后逐渐增强强度和复杂性，伴随着华丽的弦乐编排和强劲的打击乐，营造出宏大而电影般的氛围。
